clues.label: Tagline
clues.value: “An immortal legend as you've only imagined.”

clues.label: Plot
clues.value: ▇▇▇ was a small orphan who was raised by an ape named ▇▇▇ since he was a child. He believed that this was his family, but on an expedition ▇▇▇ is rescued by ▇▇▇. He then finds out that he's human. Now ▇▇▇ must make the decision as to which family he should belong to...
